description: Defines the QuicBatchWriterBuffer class, which manages an internal buffer for batching packet data in QUIC protocol implementation. Includes methods for buffer management, pushing and popping writes, and buffer state inspection.

classes.name: QuicBatchWriterBuffer
classes.description: Manages a buffer for batching multiple packet writes, supporting push, pop, and buffer state queries.

methods.name: QuicBatchWriterBuffer
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the buffer object.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all buffered writes without modifying the internal buffer.

methods.name: GetNextWriteLocation
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the next writable location in the buffer.

methods.name: PushBufferedWrite
methods.description: Adds a new write to the buffer with associated metadata.

methods.name: PopBufferedWrite
methods.description: Removes a specified number of buffered writes from the front.

methods.name: buffered_writes
methods.description: Returns the deque of buffered writes.

methods.name: SizeInUse
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes currently used in the buffer.

methods.name: Invariants
methods.description: Checks internal buffer consistency; used for debugging.
